description:
One collection with all its skins. The collection's `name`, `slug`, `count`, `total_value` and `avg_value` (cents), `released` (the earliest
member's store-acceptance date) and `skins`: every member as `{itemdefid, name, icon_url, rarity, category,
price}` ordered by price, highest first. The collection's value-over-time series is GET
/market/collection-value. Cached for 30 minutes.
name: get_skin_collection
title: One collection with all its skins
